shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-hook-form flatten Date nested form values" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && rg -n "flatten" src tests packages 2>/dev/null | head -100'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/utils/isPlainObject.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/utils/isObject.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/utils/isDateObject.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/utils/cloneObject.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"flatten\\(\" src | cat; sed -n '1,100p' src/utils/index.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/types/fields.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes"
cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-hook-form-flatten-date-leaves.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Recursive value flatteners must recognize atomic object values

A recursive form-value flattener should distinguish container objects from object-valued leaves such as Date instances. Reusing a broad object-type check can recurse into instances with no enumerable keys and silently drop the field; preserve the original instance when the value is an atomic object while retaining established array recursion behavior.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
